284e8c.title: 127.0.0.1:5001 surface discovery blocked by proxy error
284e8c.content:
Recon for exact approved target `http://127.0.0.1:5001/` was conducted with traffic explicitly pinned to `http://127.0.0.1:48080` and `NO_PROXY` removed. HTTP and HTTPS reachability checks both yielded the Caido proxy's `500 Internal Server Error` page, with body: `Repository operation failed / Could not acquire a connection to the database` (HTTPS first returns the proxy CONNECT `200`, then the same `500`). `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and `sitemap_index.xml` return the same `500`.

Bounded Katana (`-d 3 -ct 1m -jc -jsl -kf all -fx -jsonl`) produced exactly one record: `GET http://127.0.0.1:5001/` => `500 text/html; charset=utf-8`; it disclosed no target links, JavaScript, XHR/API routes, redirects, forms, parameters, or technologies. `agent-browser` invoked with `--proxy http://127.0.0.1:48080 --proxy-bypass ''` failed root navigation with `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; therefore UI interactions and the allowed disposable-account login flow were not attempted. The platform proxy journal query for host `127.0.0.1` returned zero captured requests, so no journal request IDs exist to inspect.

Raw command artifacts: `/workspace/recon_f723df73/httpx.jsonl`, `curl_http___127.0.0.1_5001_.txt`, `curl_https___127.0.0.1_5001_.txt`, `robots_sitemap_probe.txt`, `katana.jsonl`, and browser output files under `/workspace/recon_f723df73/`.

7e87f1.title: Approved local web target blocked by scope proxy
7e87f1.content: `http://127.0.0.1:5001/` could not be enumerated through the required proxy. Proxy-pinned HTTP and HTTPS reachability checks, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap_index.xml`, and bounded Katana JS/XHR/form crawl all received proxy-generated Caido `500 Internal Server Error`: `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database`. Agent-browser proxy-pinned root navigation failed `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; no UI elements were available. No disposable account was created. The live proxy journal has 0 approved-host exchanges, so raw target exchanges cannot be inspected. Raw artifacts: `/workspace/recon_f723df73/`. Treat the entire application route/auth/API surface as unresolved; do not infer endpoint absence.
